rows.definition: The durable content-addressed on-disk byte store backing the RAM-only ctxrestore stash, keyed by a dropped media turn's sha256 digest (#5163).
rows.distinction: The restart/eviction-surviving on-disk half of ctxrestore; the stash proper is RAM-only and non-durable.

rows.definition: Const naming the FAK_CTXRESTORE_CAS_DIR environment variable that overrides or disables the durable media-restore CAS directory.
rows.distinction: The env-var NAME const, distinct from the resolved directory value it selects (ctxRestoreCASDir).

rows.definition: The literal environment-variable string overriding the durable media-restore CAS directory; 'off'/'0'/'none' disable durable persistence.
rows.distinction: The literal env string, distinct from the const ctxRestoreCASEnvDir that holds it.

rows.definition: The default workspace-relative durable media-restore CAS directory (.fak/ctxrestore/cas) used when the env override is unset.
rows.distinction: The default relative path, distinct from the env override and from the resolved absolute dir.

rows.definition: Cap constant bounding the durable media-restore CAS directory, oldest-modified-out on overflow (the disk analogue of the stash caps).
rows.distinction: The durable-store capacity bound, distinct from the RAM stash's maxCtxRestoreEntriesPerSession cap.

rows.definition: Helper resolving the durable media-restore CAS directory from the environment at call time; empty string means durable persistence is off.
rows.distinction: The resolver accessor, distinct from the env-var name const ctxRestoreCASEnvDir and the default relative path ctxRestoreCASDirRel it chooses between.

rows.definition: The gateway's per-turn split of in-kernel prompt tokens by PROVENANCE source (local_compute / local_cache_hit / external_kv_transfer), orthogonal to the reuse-depth family; the three sum to the by-source prompt tokens. external_kv_transfer isolates the disaggregation dividend — tokens a remote / L3 KV tier served that a single box would otherwise have re-prefilled.
rows.distinction: Splits the SAME prompt tokens by WHERE reuse came from (source axis); distinct from x2-gateway-engine-fakgatewaykvprefix, the reuse-DEPTH family that measures HOW MUCH was reused.

rows.definition: The closed session verdict for a served session whose context window refills to the compaction limit on three consecutive turns: the compaction lever sheds, the next turn refills, and the session burns one compaction per reply without making headway. Declared in dos.toml as [reasons.COMPACTION_THRASH] and counted on the gateway metrics page whether or not the operator arms the matching stop.
rows.distinction: Not a stdlib context.Context plumbing concern (x2-context-ctx-commandcontext) and not a context-window SIZING plan (x2-context-ctx-basecontextplan): those decide how much window a turn gets, this is a verdict about the window's BEHAVIOUR OVER TIME — the observation that shedding is no longer buying progress, which no per-turn size decision can express.

rows.definition: The environment knob that arms the compaction-thrash STOP at the session gate. Unset or false leaves detection and telemetry on and the stop inert, so the serve path is byte-for-byte historical until an operator opts in — the soak-first posture the sibling expense advisory already takes.
rows.distinction: Not the verdict itself (x2-context-ctx-reasoncompactionthrash): the verdict is computed and counted unconditionally, this knob decides only whether the gate ACTS on it. Keeping them apart is what lets a deploy see the signal for a soak period before anything refuses a turn on it.

rows.definition: The gateway metrics counter naming how many served sessions reached the COMPACTION_THRASH verdict. It is the operator-visible half of the thrash detector: incremented on every thrash session regardless of whether the stop is armed, so the signal is readable before anything acts on it.
rows.distinction: Not a capacity precondition like INSUFFICIENT_AGGREGATE_HBM (insufficientaggregatehbm) or a measured capacity like AggregateHBMBytes (aggregatehbmbytes): those describe whether a workload CAN be admitted at all, while this counts sessions that were admitted and served but whose context lever stopped paying for itself.

rows.definition: Bounded process-local observation of applied Anthropic or native typed compaction, result elision, or accepted real-vDSO serving, retaining quantitative digests or an explicit proof-generation failure.
rows.distinction: Each receipt ties an executed feature to byte or lookup evidence. Catalog configuration and activation headers alone do not prove savings; the transient LookupReceipt establishes only exact-result provenance. This observation does not persist settlement evidence or authorize execution.

rows.definition: Quantitative accepted-vDSO-hit evidence binding the actual gateway call identity digest to its served payload digest; measured resident entries also carry a signed historical-engine-minus-current-lookup estimate.
rows.distinction: LookupReceipt authenticates an exact result transiently. This bounded proof records the accepted hit and explicit timing basis without claiming an internal cache key or a measured counterfactual saving. Unmeasured entries retain null timing quantities.

rows.definition: Input to the pure Anthropic byte-rewrite verifier specifying protected prefix and suffix bounds, exact claimed byte delta and labeled token estimates.
rows.distinction: The witness is verifier input rather than proof that execution occurred. The structural producer selects the real regions; the verifier checks their byte equality and measured delta before a FeatureProofReceipt can retain the result. Native typed-message observations use separately labeled representation evidence.

rows.definition: Opaque completion attestation minted by the kernel around an actual successful engine execution, binding a measured wall-clock duration to the exact call and result contents.
rows.distinction: Gateway counters aggregate observations; this transient attestation authenticates one prior execution measurement. A cache-hit duration estimate additionally requires the exact resident entry and current lookup receipt; it does not measure an avoided counterfactual execution.
